gloss: playing from memory; memorizing a musical score

definitions.gloss: playing from memory; memorizing a musical score; performing without sheet music
definitions.explanation: The act of memorizing a piece of music well enough to perform it without looking at the sheet music. A key skill for musicians, especially in classical music performance.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}を{暗譜|あんぷ}した。
{暗譜|あんぷ}で{演奏|えんそう}するのは{緊張|きんちょう}する。
examples.english: Performing from memory makes me nervous.

examples.japanese: コンクールでは{全曲|ぜんきょく}{暗譜|あんぷ}が{求|もと}められることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In competitions, memorizing all pieces is often required.

notes: Composed of {暗|あん} (memorization, by heart) + {譜|ふ} (musical score). Takes する to form a verb: {暗譜|あんぷ}する (to memorize a piece of music). Common collocations: {暗譜|あんぷ}で{弾|ひ}く (to play from memory), {暗譜|あんぷ}で{演奏|えんそう}する (to perform from memory). In classical piano and violin recitals, {暗譜|あんぷ} is generally expected. Related: {暗記|あんき} (memorization — general), {楽譜|がくふ} (sheet music).
